caveats:
The edge-matched layers are subject to the following potential limitations:

- Where countries border each other, one or even both boundaries may be less accurate than the original, definitive boundaries.  The UN Geospatial Hub boundary is generally of lower quality than the definitive COD-AB layers.

- Peripheral polygon feature shapes and the relationship of their areas to those of their internal neighbouring features may be distorted, while internal features are untouched.

- Peripheral polygon features may artificially appear to touch different, incorrect features belonging the same country.

- *In theory, peripheral polygon features may be eliminated.  This is monitored and will be specially treated if it occurs.

notes:
Guinea administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 8 Region  
- Admin 2: 34 Prefecture  
- Admin 3: 340 Sub-prefecture  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 24 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 04 March 2016: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 03 August 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 03 August 2017: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA West and Central Africa (ROWCA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rowca).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
